frames.caption: Choose a rectangle as the host.
The radial partition rule is licensed inside the circle's own vocabulary.
Transplant the radial partition rule onto the rectangle, cut into 10: the pieces are unequal.
Hybridized model of 1/10: a foreign partition rule on an illicit host.
Establish the whole region. One area, not yet partitioned.
Partition the region into parts of different areas. There is no unit fraction because the parts are unequal.
Shade some parts. Because the parts have different areas, the shaded amount is not the intended fraction.
Establish the whole region. One area, not yet partitioned.
Partition the region into equal parts, but make the wrong number: count the cuts, not the regions.

frames.caption: Establish one whole as a rectangle.
Apply the rectangle's own vertical-strip partition rule into 10 equal parts.
Shade one part: this is 1/10.

partition set: equal share structure ignored.
count equal sets: confuse counters with share name(10,2).
disembed subset: focus on subset counts(1,1).
subset size focus: subset count replaces fractional share.
compare relative size: compare raw subset sizes(1,1,equivalent).
emit: emit(equivalent).
